entities.name: Far Corner
entities.description: Neighborhood of Towashi that juts furthest into the Jukai, once a Jukai village.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: City that the Far Corner belongs to.

entities.name: Jukai
entities.description: Forest surrounding the Far Corner on two sides.

entities.name: Go-Shintai of Boundless Vigor
entities.description: Shrine at the end of Far Corner whose kami whispers dreams to followers.

entities.name: Chishiro
entities.description: Protector hired to defend the village from the Mukotai Reckoners.

entities.name: Tatsunari
entities.description: Reckoner who attacked the shrine and awakened the wrathful kami.

events.summary: Reckoner Tatsunari attacked the shrine, awakening the wrathful kami and unleashing chaos on Far Corner.
events.quote: the Reckoner Tatsunari attacked the shrine, awakening the wrathful kami

events.summary: Chishiro confronted Tatsunari and faced the reappearance of Kaima.
events.quote: Chishiro confronted Tatsunari while also facing the haunting reappearance of his former kami, Kaima

events.summary: Chishiro offered Kaima his blade in surrender and hope; Kaima chose renewal, and they left the ruins together.
events.quote: Chishiro offered Kaima his blade as an act of surrender and hope

relations.quote: The Far Corner is the part of Towashi that juts the furthest out into the Jukai
